Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2901
Investigation Summary: A functionality defect prevented completion of a Delivery Request for assessments using workflows that allow Stock-In Verification request creation without a UV Purchase Order. The issue was corrected in UAT1, validated successfully with SO# E001290027, and deployed to Production on 12/02/2025.
Important Findings: ['Delivery Request completion checks that both UV Purchase Order and UV Pool Cost - Procurement are mapped to the corresponding sales order.', 'For FUSO Owned Vehicle assessments, users can create a Stock-In Verification request after the Assessment request reaches Assessment Completed without creating a UV Purchase Order.', 'The same Create Verification Request behavior applies to Buyback, Monitor Vehicle, Cancelled Vehicle, Caravan (less than a year), and Caravan (more than a year) assessment purposes.', 'The missing UV Purchase Order caused the system to display an error requesting all key components to be mapped.', 'The corrected implementation passed UAT1 validation using SO# E001290027.']
Root Cause: The Delivery Request completion validation incorrectly required a UV Purchase Order for assessment-purpose workflows that permit Stock-In Verification request creation without a UV Purchase Order.
Resolution: The functionality was corrected in UAT1, validated successfully, and deployed to Production on 12/02/2025.

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2901
Timestamp: 2024-12-19T13:23:00
Author: Abhishek Singh.
Comment: Thank you for your support.
We have analyzed this issue and this is a bug in this functionality. When the user tries to complete the 'Delivery Request', the system checks if their Purchase Orders are mapped to that sales order(UV Purchase Order and UV Pool Cost - Procurement). And we have checked the record that you have provided and in that assessment, the Assessment purpose is 'FUSO Owned Vehicle'. In case of 'FUSO Owned Vehicle', after user approves the assessment request and status changes to 'Assessment Completed', 'Create Verification Request' button is activated and user directly creates the Stock-In Verification request, without creating the UV Purchase Order. Since while completing the delivery request, the system checks for  'UV Purchase Order' and 'UV Pool Cost - Procurement' and in this case, UV Purchase order is not created, the error popped up to map all the key components.
Along with 'FUSO Owned Vehicle', 'Create Verification Request' is active after approving the Assessment request for all the assessments with below listed 'Assessment Purpose':
 * FUSO Owned Vehicle
 * Buyback
 * Monitor Vehicle
 * Cancelled Vehicle
 * Caravan (less than a year)
 * Caravan (more than a year)
We will fix this issue on UAT environment. We can perform recovery for this record, but since Prod release in FDP is halted, we will not be able to release this incident to Prod environments until the next planned Prod release.
Regards,
Abhishek Singh.

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2901
Timestamp: 2024-12-20T05:08:00
Comment: thank you always.
We have analyzed this issue and it is a functionality defect. When a user attempts to complete a Delivery Request, the system checks whether the purchase order is mapped to the corresponding sales order (UV Purchase Order and UV Pool Cost - Procurement). When we checked the records you provided, the purpose of the assessment was "FUSO Owned Vehicle." For "FUSO Owned Vehicle", after the user approves the assessment request and the status changes to "Assessment Completed", the "Create Verification Request" button becomes active and the user can directly create a Stock-In Verification request without creating a UV purchase order. When completing a shipment request, the system checks "UV Purchase Order" and "UV Pool Cost - Procurement", but in this case, since no UV Purchase Order has been created, an error message appears asking you to map all key components.
For "FUSO Owned Vehicle", "Create Verification Request" will be activated after approving the assessment request for all assessments that fall under "Assessment Purpose" above.
FUSO Owned Vehicle
Buyback
Monitor vehicle
Canceled Vehicle
Caravan (less than 1 year)
Caravan (more than 1 year)
This issue will be fixed in the UAT environment. Although recovery efforts can be performed on this record, the FDP production release has been stopped and this incident cannot be released to production until the next scheduled production release.

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2880
Timestamp: 2024-12-17T12:43:00
Comment: Thank you very much for your continued support.
You can only change the salesperson name on quotes and orders when they are editable.
The editable states of a quote are "In Progress" and the editable states of an order are "Pending", "Changes in Progress", and "Rejected".
Once orders and quotations are approved, their respective screens become read-only and the salesperson name cannot be changed.
If you want to change the salesperson name in its current state, you can use the entity transfer screen.
This behavior is working correctly and has been confirmed by the business, so we will reject it for Jira at this time.
For "Approved" orders, please use the entity transfer screen to change the salesperson name.
If you have any questions, please let us know.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2865
Investigation Summary: A newly added Work Order (WO) was not included when updating the Job Card (JC) Work completion date/time because the WO was added after the JC reached "Maintenance Completed" status. Returning the JC to "Maintenance Started" and changing it back to "Maintenance Completed" updated the last WO date, including the added WO. The system was changed in FDP UAT1 so the JC header [Approval Request] action updates the last WO date, and the verified change was released to PROD on February 26, 2025.
Important Findings: ['The issue occurred when a WO was added after the JC status was "Maintenance Completed".', 'The "Set Acceptance Inspection" action is not active for a newly added WO when all existing WOs are already in "Acceptance Inspection" status.', 'Changing the JC from "Maintenance Completed" to "Maintenance Started" and back to "Maintenance Completed" updates the date of the last WO, including an added WO.', 'The corrective change updates the last WO date, including added WOs, when the [Approval Request] button is clicked in the JC header.', 'The change was implemented in FDP UAT1, verified in UAT-1 at JC Close, and released to PROD on February 26, 2025.']
Root Cause: A WO was added when the JC status was "Maintenance Completed", so the added WO was not included in the last WO date update.
Resolution: Modified the JC header [Approval Request] action to update the date of the last WO including added WOs; the change was verified in UAT-1 and deployed to PROD on February 26, 2025.
Technical Entities: ['FDP UAT-1', 'FDP UAT1', 'UAT-1', 'PROD', 'JC# I001287533', 'JC# I026301176', 'JC# I001288125', 'Work Order (WO)', 'Job Card (JC)', 'Work completion date/time (JC Header)', 'Vehicle Arrived', 'Vehicle Arrival', 'Acceptance Inspection', 'Set Acceptance Inspection', 'Acceptance Inspection Settings', 'Maintenance Completed', 'Maintenance Started', 'Approval Request', 'JC Close']

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2865
Timestamp: 2024-12-11T08:19:00
Author: Akash
Comment: Thank you for your ongoing support. We have investigated the issue and found that it is due to a user mis-operation. This is related to FDP UAT-1, Reference JC# I001287533.
Here are the steps we followed to replicate the issue:
1.The user created a Work Order (WO), then created and got approval for a quote. After entering the Arrival Date/Time in the Job Card (JC) header, the JC status changed to "Vehicle Arrived."
2.The user drilled down into the WO, started and stopped the work, then clicked on the "Set Acceptance Inspection" button. The WO status changed to "Acceptance Inspection."
3.Since all WOs are now in "Acceptance Inspection" status, the work completion date/time of the last WO was set to the JC's work completion date/time.
4.The user created a new WO with a template, and the customer approved the quote.
5.The user then drilled down into the new WO, started and stopped the work, and tried to click the "Set Acceptance Inspection" button.
However, this action is not allowed in the SC, as the "Set Acceptance Inspection" button is not active in this case. You can refer to SC JC# I026301176 for more details.
Please let me know if you need any further clarification or assistance.
Regards,
Akash

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2865
Timestamp: 2024-12-11T12:15:00
Comment: Japanese version of the comment above
Thank you for your continued support.
After investigating the problem you pointed out, we found that the cause was an operational error by the user. This is related to FDP UAT-1 and is an issue with reference number JC# I001287533.
Below are the steps I took to reproduce the issue:
A user creates a work order (WO) and then creates a quote and gets it approved. After entering the arrival date and time in the job card (JC) header, the JC status was changed to "Vehicle Arrival".
The user opened the WO, started and finished work, and clicked the "Set Acceptance Inspection" button. As a result, the status of the WO was changed to "Acceptance Inspection".
Since all WOs are currently in "Acceptance Inspection" status, the work completion date and time of the last WO was set to the work completion date and time of JC.
The user created a new WO with the template and the customer approved the quote.
The user then opens a new WO, starts/finishes the work, and tries to click the "Acceptance Inspection Settings" button.
However, this operation is not allowed in the SC and in this case the "Acceptance Inspection Settings" button is not active. Please refer to SC JC# I026301176 for details.
If you need further clarification or assistance, please let us know.
Thank you for your understanding.

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2865
Timestamp: 2024-12-19T03:28:00
Comment: Mr Himanshu
Thank you for your hard work.
As discussed in the meeting, the root cause is that the WO was added when the JC status was "maintenance completed".
By returning the JC status to "Maintenance Started" and switching it to "Maintenance Completed", the date of the last WO will be updated, including the added WO.
However, since the operator may forget this operation, please change it so that when you click the [Approval Request] button in the JC header, the date of the last WO is updated, including the WO.
thank you.
Service Yoshihara

Root Cause: A defect in the ODI package used to process TOB files.
Resolution: Applied an ODI patch on 2025-01-19 and implemented automated email monitoring for unprocessed TOB files.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2859
Investigation Summary: The Revise button was disabled for Quote Revision 2 after the Sales Order associated with Quote Revision 1 was cancelled. Investigation confirmed that the button logic incorrectly picked up the cancelled Sales Order status from the prior quote revision, although no Sales Order was associated with the current quote. The logic was corrected in UAT1 and released to PROD in the 14 January FDP release.
Important Findings: ['Quote Revision 1 had a Sales Order in "Approving" status; when Quote Revision 2 was approved, the prior Sales Order was cancelled and was not synchronized with Quote Revision 2.', 'The existing Revise button logic evaluated the status of the cancelled Sales Order associated with Quote Revision 1.', 'Because the evaluated Sales Order status was "Cancelled", the Revise button was disabled for Quote Revision 2.', 'The intended behavior is to disable the Revise button only when a cancelled Sales Order is associated with the current quote.', 'UAT1 testing confirmed that the Revise button was active for quotation 1-5SCFIB, revision 2, after the fix.']
Root Cause: The Revise button logic incorrectly used the cancelled Sales Order associated with the previous quote revision rather than checking for a cancelled Sales Order associated with the current quote.
Resolution: Updated the Revise button logic to check whether a cancelled Sales Order is associated with the current quote and keep the button enabled when no Sales Order is associated with the current quote. The fix was deployed to UAT1 and released to PROD in the 14 January FDP release.
Technical Entities: ['CLONE - NV_Quote_Revision', 'Sales Order', 'Quote Revision 1', 'Quote Revision 2', 'Revise button', '"Approving" status', '"Cancelled" status', 'FDP CR NV 14 Sales Revision without Change Order to be implemented', 'FDP Okayama Sprint', 'UAT1', 'PROD', 'FDP release', '1-5SCFIB', 'A001288210']

Comment: Mr. Tsunoda,
 
Thank you for your continued support.
 
As discussed in the meeting, the current feature details and fix plans are as follows:
 
user steps
1. Estimate revision 1 is created.
2. A sales order is created and remains in "Approving" status.
3. Estimate revision 2 is created.
4. Once quotation revision 2 is approved, if the sales order associated with quotation revision 1 remains in the Approving status, the sales order will be canceled and will not be synchronized with quotation revision 2.
 
Current function of the "Revise" button
1. This button currently picks up the status of the canceled sales order (associated with quote revision 1).
2. The "Modify" button is disabled because the status is "Cancelled".
 
correction plan
1. Check if there are any canceled sales orders in the current quote.
2. If a canceled sales order is associated with the current quote, the "Revise" button will be disabled.
3. In this particular case, there are no sales orders associated with the current quote (Quote Revision 2), so the Revise button remains enabled.
 
Please approve the proposed modification plan in order to proceed with development on UAT1.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2839
Investigation Summary: UV quotation details were linked to the wrong sales order when two sales orders existed for assessment H000014910. The quotation approval process selected cancelled sales order E000262435 instead of approved sales order E000268545. Functionality was updated and validated in UAT1, then released to Production on 16 December.
Important Findings: ['Assessment H000014910 had two sales orders: E000262435 in "Cancelled" status and E000268545 in "Approved" status.', 'When the quotation was approved, its details were incorrectly linked to cancelled sales order E000262435.', 'The corrective change ensures quotation details are linked only to a sales order not in "Cancelled" status.', 'The fix was tested in UAT1 using UV SO# E001282425.', 'The fix was released to Production in the 16 December release.']
Root Cause: The quotation approval functionality did not exclude sales orders in "Cancelled" status, causing quotation details to link to E000262435 rather than approved sales order E000268545.
Resolution: Updated the functionality to link quotation details only to sales orders that are not in "Cancelled" status; validated in UAT1 and released to Production on 16 December.
Technical Entities: ['UV quotation details', 'assessment H000014910', 'E000262435', 'E000268545', '"Cancelled" status', '"Approved" status', 'UAT1', 'UV SO# E001282425', 'Production']

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2829
Investigation Summary: Changing a quote to customer approved failed because the customer code used in the Job card had a null tax exempt flag. The tax exempt flag is non-nullable in Service order BC, causing the error during the quote status change. Recovery was performed to allow the user to proceed, and a fix to default null tax exempt flag values to 'N' was validated in UAT-1 and released to Production on December 16.
Important Findings: ['The failure occurred when setting the quote status to customer approved.', 'The customer code used in the Job card had a null tax exempt flag value.', 'Tax exempt flag is a non-nullable column in Service order BC.', "The corrective logic updates the tax exempt flag to 'N' when it is null for a customer.", 'The fix was validated in UAT-1 for JC# I001286847 and Quote# 1-5O8YM8.', 'The approved fix was released to Production in the December 16 release.']
Root Cause: The customer code associated with the Job card had a null tax exempt flag, which violated the non-nullable tax exempt flag column requirement in Service order BC during quote approval.
Resolution: Updated the tax exempt flag to 'N' when it is null for a customer; the fix was validated in UAT-1 and released to Production on December 16.
Technical Entities: ['Job card', 'tax exempt flag', 'Service order BC', 'UAT-1', 'JC# I001286847', 'Quote# 1-5O8YM8', 'PROD', 'Production']

Root Cause: The Body Building Name field in FDP NV Quote was configured with a 30-character input length instead of the 100-character length used in SC.
Resolution: Updated the Body Building Name field input length in FDP from 30 to 100, validated it in UAT1, and deployed the change to Production on December 16.

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2813

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2811
Investigation Summary: For Service Change Orders, Bulk Invoice field SMDO001 was mapped to Last Updated Date. A backend process changed the Last Updated Date after approval, causing SMDO001 to differ from the Posting Date. Important Findings: ['When a Service Change Order is set to Approved, it becomes read-only and its Last Updated Date normally matches the Posting Date.', 'For the affected order, a backend process changed the Last Updated Date to November 6, 2024, setting SMDO001 to 20241106.', 'SMDO001 in Bulk Invoice was originally mapped to Last Updated Date for Service Change Orders.', 'The corrective mapping uses Change Order Completion Date for SMDO001 instead of Last Updated Date.', 'Posting Date mapping in Journal Voucher was changed in the same manner.', 'The change was implemented and tested in Okayama UAT-1, then applied to production on April 14.']
Root Cause: SMDO001 in Bulk Invoice for Service Change Orders was mapped to Last Updated Date, which could be changed by a backend process after approval.
Resolution: Changed the SMDO001 mapping from Last Updated Date to Change Order Completion Date for Service Change Orders, made the same change for Posting Date in Journal Voucher, and deployed the fix to production.

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2805
Investigation Summary: For Order Activities created from quotes where SV staff had already created a Job Card, Job Card Type was blank and read-only. Investigation confirmed that Job Card No was populated while Job Card Type was set to null during Order Activity creation. The fix populated Job Card Type from the Job Card's JC Type; it was validated in UAT1 and released to Production on 16 December.
Important Findings: ['Job Card Type becomes read-only when Job Card No has a value in the Order Activity.', 'For Direct Input SV Quote cases without a Job Card, Job Card No remains null and Job Card Type is editable, so no fix was required.', 'For SV staff created Quote cases, the Order Activity received a Job Card No but Job Card Type was set to null, preventing users from entering the required value.', 'The fix was deployed to UAT1, tested using Order number E001181418, approved for Production, and released on 16 December.']
Root Cause: During Order Activity creation for activities with an existing Job Card, the system populated Job Card No but set Job Card Type to null. Because Job Card Type is read-only when Job Card No is populated, users could not enter or correct the value.
Resolution: Modified Order Activity creation to populate Job Card Type using the JC Type value from the Job Card. The change was validated in UAT1 and released to Production on 16 December.
Technical Entities: ['Order Activity', 'Job Card Type', 'Job Card No', 'Job Card', 'JC Type', 'JCO', 'Direct Input SV Quote', 'SV staff created Quote', 'UAT1', 'Production', 'Order number E001181418']

b. When the 'Job Card No' field is null in the order activity, the 'Job Card Type' field remains editable.
Below is the explanation of the two cases mentioned in the meeting:-
1. Direct Input SV Quote:-
     --> In this case Job Card is not created. So, during the creation of 'Order Activity', 'Job Card No' field is set to null. As a result, 'Job Card Type' will be editable in 'Order Activity'.
      
      Fix Plan:- There is no fix required in this case, as user can select 'JC Type', so field will not be null in this case.
       
2. SV staff created Quote:-
      --> In this case SV staff will create Job Card for the activity. So, During the creation of 'Order Activity', the 'Job Card Type' field is set to null, while the 'Job Card No' field stores JC#. This results in the 'Job Card Type' field remaining null and read-only, restricting the user from entering a value.
      
      Fix Plan:- We propose modifying the process so that during the creation of an 'Order Activity,' the system will populate the 'Job Card Type' field in 'Order Activity' using the "JC Type" value from the 'Job Card'.
Please approve this fix plan so that we can proceed with development in the UAT environment.
Kindly let us know in case of any queries.
Thanks and regards,
Laxminarayan Meena.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2796
Investigation Summary: A mismatch in sorting/order amounts was traced to differing Journal Voucher values when a BB PO line contained quantity greater than 1. Investigation identified calculation errors in Base Amount (CSJS213) and Base Amount (CSJS313) for PO- Body Building Order in Journal Voucher on the KB Side. The code fix was validated in UAT-Okayama and released to Production on 16 December.
Important Findings: ['The issue reproduced in UAT1 (Okayama version) B001284361.', 'JV values differed when a BB PO line item had quantity greater than 1.', 'The affected Journal Voucher fields were Base Amount (CSJS213) and Base Amount (CSJS313) for PO- Body Building Order.', 'The calculation issue was identified on the KB Side.', 'The fix was completed in UAT-Okayama before Production deployment.']
Root Cause: Calculation errors in Base Amount (CSJS213) and Base Amount (CSJS313) for PO- Body Building Order in Journal Voucher on the KB Side, affecting BB PO lines with quantity greater than 1.
Resolution: Corrected the code in UAT-Okayama, obtained approval, and released the fix to Production in the 16 December release.
Technical Entities: ['UAT1', 'Okayama version', 'B001284361', 'BB PO', 'JV', 'Journal Voucher', 'PO- Body Building Order', 'Base Amount (CSJS213)', 'Base Amount (CSJS313)', 'KB Side', 'UAT-Okayama', 'Production', 'FDP AMS', 'MFTBCFCR-162', 'D0X20842']

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2781
Investigation Summary: User D8HITASH could not edit the UI because the assigned position type, Branch-Sales-Staff, grants read-only access in the Aomori view role matrix for responsibility MF Branch-Sales-Staff. The position was assigned from the employee master file received under SR MFTBCFFR-2703, where the provided position string mapped to Branch-Sales-Staff rather than Branch NV/UV Sales Staff. The behavior was determined to be correct per the configured role matrix, not a product defect.
Important Findings: ['User D8HITASH was assigned the Branch-Sales-Staff position type.', 'In the Aomori view role matrix, the view is read-only for the MF Branch-Sales-Staff responsibility.', 'Users with the Branch NV/UV Sales Staff position type have editable access to the view.', 'The employee master file received in SR MFTBCFFR-2703 contained a position string that referred to Branch-Sales-Staff.', 'The proposed correction requires updating the JPN string for Branch NV/UV Sales Staff and updating the employee master assignment for D8HITASH.']
Root Cause: The employee master file assigned D8HITASH the Branch-Sales-Staff position because its position string referred to Branch-Sales-Staff instead of Branch NV/UV Sales Staff; this position has read-only access under the Aomori view role matrix.
Technical Entities: ['D8HITASH', 'Branch-Sales-Staff', 'Branch NV/UV Sales Staff', 'Aomori', 'view role matrix', 'MF Branch-Sales-Staff', 'SR MFTBCFFR-2703', 'Employee master', 'JPN string']

Author: Abhishek Singh.
Comment: Thank you for your support.
We have analyzed this issue and we have found that the user 'D8HITASH' has a position type as 'Branch-Sales-Staff'. We checked the view role matrix for Aomori environment and as per that document, this view is read-only for users with responsibility 'MF Branch-Sales-Staff'. Hence, for this user, you are not able to make any changes on UI.
And for other 'Sales-Staff' users, they have position type as 'Branch NV/UV Sales Staff', for which, as per the view role matrix, this view is editable.
If business requires, we can change the position type for this user to 'Branch NV/UV Sales Staff'. You will need to raise an SR to update the Employee master, with corresponding position for this user in the employee master file.
Since this is working correctly as per the existing functionality and is not a bug, kindly allow us to reject this Jira.
Thanks,
Abhishek Singh.

Root Cause: A problem in the ODI package caused TOB files to remain unprocessed.
Resolution: An ODI patch was applied to FDP Production environments on 2025-01-19, and automated email monitoring for unprocessed or failed TOB files was implemented. Subsequent monitoring confirmed no further discrepancies caused by the ODI failure.

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2751

Root Cause: The user set the Sub-Quote Active Flag to "N", making the Sub-Quote inactive and therefore not editable.
Resolution: Set the Sub-Quote Active Flag to "Y" and then change the status.

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2704
Timestamp: 2024-11-07T15:56:51+00:00
Author: Himanshu Tandon
Comment: Mr. Shiromoto,
Thank you for your help.
Problem: UV Inbox Approval Error
Cause Investigation (RCA): User steps are as follows:
1. We have created Quotation-1-1WQC6R (revised version 1) and approved the quotation.
2. Order "E000247317" has been created.
3． You generated an approval for the order by clicking the Request Approval button.
4. The order remained in the "Waiting for approval" state because the user did not approve the order.
5. The user clicked the Revise button to create a new quote (Revision 2) and approve the quote.
6. The order was still in the "Awaiting Approval" state, so after approving the quotation -1-1WQC6R (Revised Version 2), the order's status became "Cancelled".
7. The user then tried to "Reject" or "Approved" the order, but was unable to do so because there was no possibility to change the order's status from "Cancelled" to "Rejected" or "Approved".
Remediation plan: No modification required. The problem is due to user error.
In the above scenario: The user must first approve the order and then revise the quote. Or you should create a new order instead of using the canceled order.
If you have any questions, please let us know.
Thank you very much for your support.
Himanshu

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2704
Timestamp: 2024-11-06T11:54:21+00:00
Author: Laxminarayan Meena
Comment: Dear San,
Thank you for your support.
Issue:- UV In-Box Approval Error.
RCA:- User steps are as follows:-
1. Created Quote '1-1WQC6R' revision 1 and approved the quote.
2. Created Sales Order 'E000247317'.
3. Generated Approvals of sales order by clicking on "Generate Approval" button.
4. Sales Order status left in "Pending Approval" as user has not approved the sales order.
5. User created a new quote with revision 2 by clicking on "Revise" button and approved the quote.
6. As Sales order was left in 'Pending Approval' status, by approving quote '1-1WQC6R' revision 2, Sales order status was set to "Cancelled".
7. Then user tried to Reject/Approve the sales order but it was not possible to Reject/Approve it because Sales order status can not be changed from "Cancelled" to "Rejected/Approved".
 
Fix Plan:-No Fix required. As the issue occured due to user mis operation.
In the above scenario:-
Either User should approve the Sales Order first and then should revise the quote, Or User should create a new Sales order instead of using the cancelled sales order.
Kindly let us know in case of any queries.
Thanks and regards,
Laxminarayan Meena.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2700
Investigation Summary: The FVP flag in Material Master was being set to null for all parts received in the Material Master file. Investigation found that an FVP flag mapping existed even though D2S did not provide the FVP flag in the Material Master file. The mapping was inactivated in FDP UAT and then released to Prod.
Important Findings: ['D2S does not provide the FVP flag in the Material Master file.', 'An existing Material Master mapping for the FVP flag caused the FVP flag to be set to null for all incoming parts.', 'The FVP flag mapping was inactivated in FDP UAT.', 'The change was released to Prod.']
Root Cause: A Material Master mapping expected an FVP flag value that was not provided by D2S, causing the FVP flag to be set to null for all parts in the Material Master file.
Resolution: Inactivated the FVP flag mapping in FDP UAT and released the change to Prod.
Technical Entities: ['FVP flag', 'Material Master', 'D2S', 'Material Master file', 'FDP UAT', 'Prod']

Root Cause: The View Role Matrix configured "MF UV Purchase Order Attachment View" as "Read Only" for the "MF Branch-Sales-Staff" responsibility, disabling the "New" attachment button.
Resolution: Updated the relevant View Role Matrix configuration to enable the "New" attachment button for "MF Branch-Sales-Staff" in FDP UAT and Production, including Okayama, Aomori, and Hakodate Prod.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2678
Investigation Summary: The affected Labors were associated with an External Work Order, which caused a Service PO to be created and categorized as Outsourcing(External). For Line Item Type -External, account code 271-20 is mapped as the Credit Account Code. FDP requires certain special vendors to use the Internal work order account code despite users creating External Work Orders; no FDP functionality was available to support this requirement.
Important Findings: ['The affected Labors were linked to an External Work Order and therefore generated a Service PO under Outsourcing(External).', 'Line Item Type -External is mapped to Credit Account Code 271-20.', 'FDP has special vendors that are not considered external, but users create External Work Orders for them.', 'Siebel sends the correct account code; the required FDP-specific handling was not introduced during initial JV development.', 'Implementing the requested FDP functionality was considered difficult development at the time.']
Root Cause: FDP lacks functionality to apply Internal work order account codes for special FDP vendors when users create an External Work Order, causing the External Work Order account-code mapping to be used.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2673
Investigation Summary: A position code was unavailable in the PROD Position Code Pick Applet. Investigation found that the FPDA and FDPH dataload file set the Dissassembly flag (Daimler Code) to 'N' for position code '99999', preventing it from appearing in the UI. The data issue was corrected and the incident was closed.
Important Findings: ["WO Header Position codes with Dissassembly flag (Daimler Code) set to 'Y' are visible in the Position Code Pick Applet.", "The FPDA and FDPH dataload file contained Dissassembly flag value 'N' for position code '99999'.", "Position code '99999' did not appear in the UI because its Dissassembly flag was set to 'N'.", 'The issue was identified as a PROD data issue and was fixed.']
Root Cause: The FPDA and FDPH dataload file set the Dissassembly flag (Daimler Code) to 'N' for position code '99999', which excluded it from the Position Code Pick Applet UI.
Resolution: Corrected the PROD data issue for position code '99999' so it could appear in the UI.
Technical Entities: ['PROD', 'UAT', 'WO Header', 'Position Code Pick Applet', 'Dissassembly flag (Daimler Code)', 'FPDA', 'FDPH', "position code '99999'", 'Service Position Code Master file']

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2663
Investigation Summary: The quote approval behavior for a local part was investigated in UAT. Approval eligibility is based on cost ratio rather than discount rate; the observed incorrect automatic approval when 1% Less Overwrite was entered was attributed to a UAT-only data issue. The data issue was fixed on UAT-1, while RT2 Quote# 1-E26NK6 was confirmed to work correctly.
Important Findings: ['Local parts approval criteria use cost ratio, not discount rate.', 'For customer quotes with local parts, a cost ratio between 0 and 105 should route approval to the Branch Parts Manager.', 'The customer LPP res in the discount master is 10%, and sales price is determined from this master.', 'Cost rate is calculated from Sales Price and Cost price; overwritten Less or price higher than the Sales Price may bypass the approval flow.', 'The issue occurred only in UAT and was not reproduced in production on RT2 Quote# 1-E26NK6.', 'The UAT data issue was fixed on UAT-1.']
Root Cause: A data issue in the UAT environment caused the approval flow to behave incorrectly when 1% Less Overwrite was entered.
Resolution: The UAT data issue was fixed on UAT-1.

Comment: Hi Akash san
The LPP res set in the discount master for this customer is 10%.
 When a part number is entered, the sales price is determined based on this master.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2640
Investigation Summary: For Body Building Order B000160867, Journal Voucher Lines for PO and Consumption Tax were not created because the order amount was 0 after the line item was cancelled. The Consumption Tax field retained tax calculated before cancellation because it is a column-based field and is not updated when a line item is cancelled. This behavior was confirmed as expected, and the incident was closed without a corrective change.
Important Findings: ['Body Building Order B000160867 had an order amount of 0 because its line item was cancelled.', 'Journal Voucher Lines for PO and its Consumption Tax were not created when the order amount was 0.', 'The Consumption Tax field stores the total tax from line-item amounts when amounts are entered.', 'Consumption Tax is not updated when a line item is cancelled because it is a column-based field.', "Body Building Orders with cancelled line items can still have the status 'Acceptance Verification Done'."]
Root Cause: The line item for Body Building Order B000160867 was cancelled, causing the order amount to become 0; therefore, Journal Voucher Lines for PO and Consumption Tax were not created.
Resolution: No system correction was required; the behavior was explained as expected and the Jira was closed.
Technical Entities: ['Body Building Order', 'B000160867', 'Journal Voucher Lines', 'PO', 'Consumption Tax', 'Acceptance Verification Done']

Timestamp: 2024-10-04T10:59:00
Author: Laxminarayan Meena.
Comment: Dear Miyauchi San,
Thank you for your support.
Here is the explanation of your queries:-
Question:1 Why is consumption tax is present in Body Building Order even with zero order amount?
Answer: We have checked the 'Consumption Tax' field on Body Building Orders. It is a column based field which stores the total tax of line items when amount is entered in line items. Since, it is column based field, tax is not updated when line item is cancelled.
 
Question:2 Can Acceptance verification be done for Body building order when the line item is cancelled?
Answer: Yes, 'Acceptance Verification Done' status is possible for Body Building Orders with cancelled line items.
Please let us know in case of any other queries.

Investigation Summary: A rounding issue affected Job Cards with the "Field Fix Flag" set to "Y", causing the error "There is an open field fix" during Job Card creation. The issue was replicated in UAT-1 using JC I001272562 and released in the 3rd Oct 2024 FDP release. Important Findings: ['Job Cards with the "Field Fix Flag" marked "Y" failed creation with the error "There is an open field fix".', 'The issue was identified as a rounding issue affecting all Job Cards with the flag set to "Y".', 'The issue was replicated in UAT-1 using JC I001272562.', 'The fix was released in the 3rd Oct 2024 FDP release.', 'Post-release monitoring found no newly created Job Cards with a null rounding value in all three environments.']
Root Cause: A rounding issue resulted in null rounding values for Job Cards with the "Field Fix Flag" set to "Y", causing the "There is an open field fix" error during Job Card creation.
Resolution: Released the fix in the 3rd Oct 2024 FDP release and monitored newly created Job Cards; the issue was confirmed fixed in Production.

Root Cause: The Job Card was set to closed from the backend during recovery, causing abnormalities in the JV creation process and resulting in an incorrect JV.
Resolution: Recovered the incorrect JVs and completed the recovery; added a planned recovery-process check to verify JVs created for recovered items.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2575
Investigation Summary: Address changes made in Basic Info/Customer information were not consistently synchronized to AR/AP and Quote BIP. Investigation found that Service Quote BIP and AR used different backend Siebel field mappings, and the synchronization behavior available in FDP was not present in the SC version. The fix was validated in UAT-1 and released to PROD in the 21st Nov FDP Release.
Important Findings: ['Updating an address through the Customer Update/Update Customer function did not update the AR address in the SC version.', 'For Quote BIP address updates, users were initially instructed to use the Update AR button.', 'Service Quote BIP and AR address fields had different backend Siebel mappings.', 'The FDP implementation updates the AR address when the Customer Address is updated; this functionality originated from FDP-AAC-01 Merge AR/ AP into one Finance Account.', 'In UAT-1, changes to the address in Basic Info were reflected in AR/AP and synchronized to BIP.', 'The fix was deployed to PROD in the 21st Nov FDP Release.']
Root Cause: Service Quote BIP and AR had different backend Siebel field mappings, and the FDP address-synchronization functionality was not present in the SC version.
Resolution: The address synchronization issue was fixed in UAT-1, validated by testing, and deployed to PROD in the 21st Nov FDP Release.
Technical Entities: ['Customer Update', 'Update Customer', 'Update AR', 'Quote BIP', 'Service Quote BIP', 'AR', 'AP', 'AR/AP', 'FDP', 'SC version', 'FDP-AAC-01 Merge AR/ AP into one Finance Account', 'Siebel', 'UAT-1', 'PROD', 'Basic Info', 'Customer info', '21st Nov FDP Release']

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2569
Investigation Summary: Approval generation for an Assessment Request did not trigger the expected rule because the requesting user’s primary position was set incorrectly. User D8KOUSTA had both Branch-CS-Staff and Branch NV/UV Sales Staff Position, but Branch-CS-Staff was configured as the primary position. The Assessment Request was reverted to "In Progress" so the user could set Branch NV/UV Sales Staff as primary and regenerate approval.
Important Findings: ['Approval processing evaluates the requesting user’s primary position.', 'User D8KOUSTA had both Branch-CS-Staff and Branch NV/UV Sales Staff Position.', 'Branch-CS-Staff was configured as D8KOUSTA’s primary position, preventing the expected approval rule from triggering.', 'Changing the primary position to Branch NV/UV Sales Staff allows the approval rule to trigger correctly.', 'The Assessment Request status was changed back to "In Progress" to enable recovery and approval regeneration.', 'The incident was identified as user mis-operation rather than a system issue.']
Root Cause: User D8KOUSTA had Branch-CS-Staff configured as the primary position instead of Branch NV/UV Sales Staff, while approval rules use the requester’s primary position.
Resolution: Reverted the Assessment Request to "In Progress" and instructed the user to set Branch NV/UV Sales Staff as the primary position before selecting "Generate Approval".
Technical Entities: ['Assessment Request', 'Employees screen', 'D8KOUSTA', 'Branch-CS-Staff', 'Branch NV/UV Sales Staff Position', 'Branch NV/UV Sales Staff', 'Primary Position', 'Generate Approval', 'In Progress']

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2556
Timestamp: 2024-09-25T13:18:00
Author: Madhav
Comment: Thank you for your support.
Please find below the observation points for this incident:
1.Consumption Tax Calculation have been fixed for both negative and positive cases.
 
2.Round up, Round down and Round Off Functionality had been implemented through MFTBCFFR-2374 AMS-CR_SV_Rounding of Consumption Tax(Master) only for Quote Header , not for Quote Line items due to which Line items are getting 'Round Off' and 'Round Down' depending upon the Data type of the Fields present in SC and FDP versions.
 
3.In SC version , Consumption Tax is getting stored in the Field having Type as 'DTYPE_CURRENCY' which by default does the rounding as "Round Off" in Line Items.
 
4.In FDP version , Consumption Tax is getting stored in the Field having Data Type as "DTYPE_INTEGER" which by default does the rounding as "Round Down" in the Line Items, 
 
5.In SC Version , there's no rounding in the Quote Header as the CR is only implemented in FDP Version
Regards,
Madhav

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2555
Investigation Summary: The incident concerned Tax/Non-Tax Flag and Tax Rate synchronization in the Quote/JCO Header when the customer was changed in the JC Header in FDP UAT1. The issue was fixed and validated in UAT-1 using new JCs I001281065 and I001281069. The change was subsequently released to Prod.
Important Findings: ['Initial synchronization of Flag and Tax Value in the Quote Header was corrected in FDP UAT1.', 'Changing the customer in the JC Header from TAX to Non TAX, or from Non TAX to TAX, did not update the Flag in the Quote Header.', 'In the SC version, the TAX Flag remained correctly linked when the customer was changed.', 'After the fix, the Non-Tax Flag and Tax Rate values in the Quote/JCO Header were correct for JC I001281065 and Quote 1-5KJ6FX.', 'Customer update behavior was validated for JC I001281069 with Account Code 0000B18463.']
Root Cause: The Tax/Non-Tax Flag linkage from the JC Header customer change to the Quote Header was not updating correctly in FDP UAT1.
Resolution: Fixed the tax flag linkage with customer changes in UAT1, validated the Quote/JCO Header values, and released the change to Prod.

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2538
Investigation Summary: For Journal Event Type Tax - Weight Tax, Credit Client Code (CSJS308) is mapped to Expenses Payee Code on the Service Expenses Request Screen. The Expenses Payee Code was null for three affected Job Card Orders, and the issue was replicated in Okayama UAT. The field is user-editable and Service Expenses can be completed without validation when the field is cleared.
Important Findings: ['Credit Client Code (CSJS308) for Journal Event Type Tax - Weight Tax is mapped to Expenses Payee Code on the Service Expenses Request Screen.', 'Expenses Payee Code was null for JC#-I000159484, JC#-I000159577, and JC#-I000158774.', 'Expenses Payee Code is editable by users.', 'Service Expenses can be completed without validation when Expenses Payee Code is null.', 'The issue was replicated in Okayama UAT.']
Root Cause: Users can clear the editable Expenses Payee Code field, and the Service Expenses Request Screen allows the Expense to be completed without validation despite the field being null.
Technical Entities: ['Journal Event Type Tax - Weight Tax', 'Credit Client Code (CSJS308)', 'Expenses Payee Code', 'Service Expenses Request Screen', 'Okayama UAT', 'JC#-I000159484', 'JC#-I000159577', 'JC#-I000158774', 'Service Expenses']

Timestamp: 2024-09-02T08:24:00
Comment: Dear Miyauchi San,
As per our investigation,
The KB batch is automated, but this was an ad-hoc request for Aomori/Hakodate. Manual execution was carried out to process and send the files to KB, and validation was required.
During testing, dummy files were created, including the ctrl.txt file. The system automatically replaces the old ctrl.txt file with a new one when the batch is executed again. However, in the Hakodate environment, the old ctrl.txt file was open in one of the sessions during testing. As a result, when the actual batch execution took place, the new ctrl.txt file was not replaced. 
The Recovery has been completed on our side.
Please allow us to close this incident.
Thanks
Amit

comments.comment:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2747
Timestamp: 2024-08-29T07:45:41+00:00
Author: Himanshu Tandon
Comment: good work.
Chassis order number: B000159393
After investigating this issue, we found that the posting date was mapped to the actual shipping date of the PO (chassis order).
Chassis orders are created using the D21E file received from the TOB, and when the status of the chassis order becomes "shipping ordered", a JV (journal entry voucher) is created. For this order, the actual shipping date was updated to 20240731 through the D21Z file received from the TOB, and then the JV was submitted, so the Posting date was set to 20240731.
 The current logic is that if the actual shipping date is null, the JV's Posting date will be set to the timestamp when the JV was created.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2482
Investigation Summary: Payment Amount Total (Tax) displayed incorrectly in the List Applet after JCT because it retained an older field mapping based on the total line item tax sum. The Form used the correct header-based tax calculation. The List Applet mapping was updated and validated in UAT1, then released to PROD in the 29 Aug FDP Release.
Important Findings: ['The Payment Amount Total (Tax) field mapping in the List Applet was an older mapping based on total line item tax sum.', 'After JCT, tax calculation was based on the total header amount.', 'The List Applet field mapping was not changed during the JCT Release.', 'After the UAT1 update, Payment Amount Total (Tax) matched correctly in both the Form and List Applet.', 'No business-process or calculation impact was identified, and no recovery was required.']
Root Cause: The List Applet retained an outdated Payment Amount Total (Tax) field mapping based on total line item tax sum instead of the post-JCT total header amount calculation.
Resolution: Updated the Payment Amount Total (Tax) field mapping in the List Applet on UAT1, obtained validation that Form and List Applet values matched, and deployed the change to PROD in the 29 Aug FDP Release.
Technical Entities: ['Payment Amount Total (Tax)', 'List Applet', 'Form', 'JCT', 'JCT Release', 'UAT1', 'UAT-1', 'PROD', 'FDP Release']

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2476
Investigation Summary: The "Submit to TOB" button was inactive for a Chassis Order because its selected model code had Product Line "Bus". The implemented logic, consistent with SC, enables the button only for Product Line "Truck". Recovery was completed by changing the Product Line of model code "BG740GBAGG-5" to "Truck", after which the button became active.
Important Findings: ['"Submit to TOB" is active only for model codes with Product Line "Truck".', 'The affected Chassis Order used a model code with Product Line "Bus", causing the button to remain inactive.', 'SC contains the same logic and the same model code was also classified as Product Line "Bus" in SC.', 'Product Line for model code "BG740GBAGG-5" was updated to "Truck".', 'After the Product Line update, the "Submit to TOB" button became active and recovery was completed.']
Root Cause: The affected model code was configured with Product Line "Bus", while the implemented "Submit to TOB" logic enables the button only for Product Line "Truck".
Resolution: Updated the Product Line of model code "BG740GBAGG-5" from "Bus" to "Truck", which activated the "Submit to TOB" button.
Technical Entities: ['Submit to TOB', 'TOB', 'Chassis Order', 'Product Line', 'Bus', 'Truck', 'Model Code', 'BG740GBAGG-5', 'SC', 'MFTBCFFR-2479']

*Current Functionality of the Approval Eligibility Master:*
When the following conditions are met:
 * *Customer Type* is _Parts Trader_
 * *Parts Group* is _Competitive_
 * *Parts Type* is _Genuine_
 * *Discount Rate* is either:
 ** Between *5 and 55*, inclusive (i.e., {{5 ≤ Discount Rate ≤ 55}}), or
 ** Between *55 and 100*, exclusive (i.e., {{55 < Discount Rate < 100}})
Then, the *approval flow is triggered*.
However, in the current case (for Quote# :- 1-68WPKL), the *Discount Rate is exactly 100 (*{{*Discount Rate = 100*}}*)*, which falls *outside the defined conditions*. As a result, *no approval flow is triggered*.
Please check and verify.

Akash

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2462
Investigation Summary: Recycle Fee data was not displayed because the D21F file received on 20 Aug evening was not processed by ODI. During recovery of MFTBCFFR-2441, opening D21F in the Aomori Prod Inbound folder caused it to no longer be treated as the latest file on the path, so the ODI package detected no file. Recovery was completed in production and Recycle Fee data displayed correctly.
Important Findings: ['The D21F file received on 20 Aug evening was not processed by ODI.', 'During MFTBCFFR-2441 recovery, D21E files were re-run in the Aomori Prod environment.', 'D21F was opened while present in the Inbound folder, causing it to no longer be the latest file on the path.', 'When the ODI package executed, it searched for the latest file and detected no file.', 'Recovery was completed on prod, and no pending recoveries remained.']
Root Cause: During D21E recovery for MFTBCFFR-2441 in Aomori Prod, opening the D21F file in the Inbound folder caused it to no longer be recognized as the latest file; the ODI package therefore detected no file and did not process D21F.
Resolution: Recovered the data in prod so Recycle Fee data displayed correctly, and added a recovery step to not open additional files present in the Inbound folder.
Technical Entities: ['Recycle Fee data', 'D21F', 'ODI', 'MFTBCFFR-2441', 'D21E', 'Aomori Prod environment', 'Inbound folder', 'ODI package', 'prod']

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2462
Timestamp: 2024-08-22T12:23:00
Author: Divyesh Ghiya
Comment: Thank you for your support.
We investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
The issue occurred because D21F file received on 20 Aug evening was not processed in ODI.
During the recovery of incident MFTBCFFR-2441, we were re-running D21E files in Aomori Prod environment. At that time, D21F file was present in the Inbound folder, we were checking the data of the files and opened D21F file too, this caused D21F not be latest file on path. When ODI package was executed, it searched for the latest file and no file was detected. 
Countermeasure: We generally do not perform recovery of D21 files, but for the future we have added an extra step to not open additional files present in the Inbound folder.
Recovery is completed now on prod and recycle fee data is shown correctly. Please allow us to close the incident.
Please let us know if you have any query.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2462
Timestamp: 2024-08-23T04:40:00
Comment: Japanese version of the above email,
Thank you for your continued support.
We investigated this matter and found the following:
A problem arose because the D21F file we received on the evening of August 20th was not processed by ODI.
During incident recovery work for MFTBCFFR-2441, we were reprocessing D21E files in our production environment in Aomori. At that time, the D21F file was present in the inbound folder and I checked the data in the file and opened the D21F file as well, so the D21F file was no longer the latest file on the path. As a result, when the ODI package was run, it searched for the latest files and no files were found.
As a precautionary measure, while we do not normally perform recovery operations on D21 files, we have taken an additional step to ensure that we do not open any additional files located in the inbound folder in the future.
Recovery in the production environment is complete and recycling fee data is displayed correctly. We will now close the incident. Thank you for your understanding.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2447
Investigation Summary: Sequence values were reviewed for MF Reservation Number, MF Sequence Number, and MF Shipment Number across Aomori and Hakodate. The RES_NUM and SR_NUM sequences were reset to 1 because no related records existed in either environment. SHIPMENT_NUM was not reset because shipment records had already been created in the Aomori environment.
Important Findings: ['MF Reservation Number uses Reservation Request.X_RES_NUM and Oracle sequence RES_NUM; both Aomori and Hakodate values were 1200 with no records present.', 'MF Sequence Number uses Assesment Request.X_SEQ_NUM and Oracle sequence SR_NUM; both Aomori and Hakodate values were 6505 with no records present.', 'MF Shipment Number uses Parts Shipment.X_SHIPMENT_NUM and Oracle sequence SHIPMENT_NUM; its value was 106523 and shipment records existed in Aomori.', 'RES_NUM and SR_NUM were reset, while SHIPMENT_NUM was intentionally not reset.']
Resolution: Reset the RES_NUM and SR_NUM Oracle sequences to 1. Do not reset SHIPMENT_NUM because shipment records already exist in the Aomori environment.
Technical Entities: ['MF Reservation Number', 'Parts', 'Reservation Request', 'X_RES_NUM', 'RES_NUM', 'Oracle Sequence Object', 'Aomori', 'Hakodate', 'MF Sequence Number', 'UV', 'Assesment Request', 'X_SEQ_NUM', 'SR_NUM', 'MF Shipment Number', 'Parts Shipment', 'X_SHIPMENT_NUM', 'SHIPMENT_NUM', 'Aomori env']

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2441
Investigation Summary: Drilldown failed in the Aomori production environment because chassis order data referenced an invalid position ID. Investigation identified an incorrect value in Contact.PR_HELD_POSTN_ID: a Hakodate environment ID was applied in Aomori. The correct data was recovered, drilldown and chassis orders functioned normally, and D21E files processed successfully.
Important Findings: ['Contact.PR_HELD_POSTN_ID stores the ID for "SCHQ-Sales-Vehicle-Staff" required by chassis order data.', 'PR_HELD_POSTN_ID is manually updated after employee master processing.', 'The same ID was updated in both Aomori and Hakodate environments, but the ID used belonged to Hakodate.', 'The Hakodate ID caused an error in Aomori production while functioning normally in Hakodate.', 'All chassis orders were recovered, drilldown was restored, and D21E files processed successfully.', 'AMS process controls will be added to validate that the updated ID belongs to the correct environment.']
Root Cause: A Hakodate environment ID for "SCHQ-Sales-Vehicle-Staff" was manually written to Contact.PR_HELD_POSTN_ID in the Aomori production environment.
Resolution: Recovered all chassis orders and restored normal functionality; add AMS process validation to verify that manually updated PR_HELD_POSTN_ID values are correct for the target environment.
Technical Entities: ['Aomori production', 'Hakodate environment', 'Contact table', 'PR_HELD_POSTN_ID', 'SCHQ-Sales-Vehicle-Staff', 'chassis order data', 'employee master', 'AMS process', 'D21E files']

Timestamp: 2024-08-20T10:44:00
Author: Divyesh Ghiya
Comment: Mr. Tsunoda,
Thank you for your continued support.
After a detailed analysis of this issue, we found the following:
This issue in the Aomori production occurred because an incorrect value existed in PR_HELD_POSTN_ID in the Contact table. This column contains the ID of "SCHQ-Sales-Vehicle-Staff" and is required for chassis order data.
I am manually updating this column after the employee master is processed, and this time the same ID was updated in both Aomori and Hakodate environments. The ID used was from the Hakodate environment, and this caused the error in the Aomori environment, but was working fine in the Hakodate environment. I also checked if the ID was updated correctly during validation.
Countermeasure: Since it is a manual task, we will add a countermeasure to the AMS process and also check if the updated ID is correct. This ensures that the correct ID is updated.
All chassis orders have been recovered and are functioning normally. We would like to ask you to close this incident.
If you have any questions, please let us know.
thank you.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2423
Investigation Summary: Chassis order B000083482 displayed no price because it was created before the corresponding production price data was available. The issue was identified as a data issue rather than a system or code issue. All chassis orders with blank amounts that were created before their price data were recovered.
Important Findings: ['Chassis order B000083482 was created on 16/01/2024, while its production price data was created on 23/01/2024.', 'Price data was unavailable during chassis order creation, so no price was reflected in the Chassis Order.', 'The incident was classified as a data issue, not a system or code issue.', 'All Chassis Orders created before their price data was created were extracted for recovery.', 'Recovery was completed for all identified records with blank amounts.']
Root Cause: The affected Chassis Orders were created before the corresponding production price data existed, causing prices to remain blank.
Resolution: Recovered all identified Chassis Orders with blank amounts after reviewing the extracted recovery records.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2419
Investigation Summary: Trade-In synchronization created UV Purchase Orders when revised and approved quotes synchronized to sales orders that were not in an appropriate status. In the NV flow, this occurred after an NV Sales Order approval was rejected; in the UV flow, it occurred while the UV Sales Order remained Pending. The issue was fixed in UAT1, validated with test sales orders, and released to Production in the 13 September FDP release.
Important Findings: ['Revision 2 of NV Quote# 1-UJYUK synchronized after approval and generated PO# F000110671 although the associated order# A000109884 had been rejected.', 'The Trade-In synchronization process did not account for an NV Sales Order in Rejected status.', 'For NV Quotes, revising and approving a quote after rejecting the generated NV Sales Order triggered creation of a UV Purchase Order for the Trade-In.', 'For UV Quotes, revising and approving a quote triggered creation of a UV Purchase Order for the Trade-In while the UV Sales Order remained Pending.', 'The fix was validated in UAT1 using NV SO#A001268431 and UV SO#E001268440 before Production deployment.']
Root Cause: Trade-In synchronization generated UV Purchase Orders without properly accounting for the status of the associated sales order, including NV Sales Orders in Rejected status and UV Sales Orders in Pending status.
Resolution: The issue was fixed in UAT1 and released to Production in the 13 September FDP release.

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2419
Timestamp: 2024-08-08T05:37:00
Author: Sunil Kumar
Comment: Thank you for your support.
We have found rca of this issue and are describing below step by step:-
For NV Case:
1.The user created an NV Quote with a Trade-In and used the auto-order button to generate an NV Sales Order, which initially had a status of 'Pending'.
2.The user then clicked the 'Generate Approval' button for the NV Sales Order but rejected the approval, resulting in the NV Sales Order status being updated to 'Rejected'.
3.The user revised the NV Quote (Revision 1) to NV Quote (Revision 2) and approved NV Quote (Revision 2).
4.NV Quote (Revision 2) synchronized with the NV Sales Order, triggering the creation of a UV Purchase Order for the Trade-In.
5.Since the Auto Order button is enabled in NV Quote (Revision 2), the user can generate a new NV Sales Order by clicking it.
Even though the NV Sales Order is in a 'Rejected' status, a UV Purchase Order for the Trade-In will created.
For UV Case:
1.The user created a UV Quote with a Trade-In and used the auto-order button to generate a UV Sales Order with a 'Pending' status.
2.Revise UV Quote(Revision 1) to UV Quote(Revision 2) and approved UV Quote(Revision 2)
3.UV Quote (Revision 2) synchronized with the UV Sales Order, triggering the creation of a UV Purchase Order for the Trade-In.
Even though the UV Sales Order is in 'Pending' status, a UV Purchase Order for Trade In will create.
Let us know if you have any query.

Sunil Kumar

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2407
Investigation Summary: Employee 6882 had two inactive employee master records for Okayama-Production. A department master update during the 22 July 2024 FDPO Release caused both records to be sent to KB. The existing MFTBCFFR-1978 solution covered only one active and one inactive record, so a new rule was implemented in the 26 August 2024 FDP Release to send the latest inactive record to KB.
Important Findings: ['Employee 6882 had two inactive records in the employee master for Okayama-Production.', 'The department master update during the 22 July 2024 FDPO Release triggered transmission of the inactive records to KB.', 'MFTBCFFR-1978 handled multiple records only when one record was active and one was inactive.', 'The new behavior for multiple inactive records is to send the latest inactive record to KB.', 'The solution was released to Prod in the 26 August 2024 FDP Release.']
Root Cause: The existing multiple-record handling logic from MFTBCFFR-1978 did not support cases where an employee had two inactive employee master records.
Resolution: Implemented and released a Prod change in the 26 August 2024 FDP Release to send the latest inactive record to KB when multiple inactive records exist.
Technical Entities: ['Employee 6882', 'employee master', 'Okayama-Production', 'department master', 'FDPO Release', 'KB', 'MFTBCFFR-1978', 'Prod', 'FDP Release']

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2402
Investigation Summary: Recycle fee orders could not be registered because affected orders passed a value of '0' instead of the net price. Investigation identified a master flag changed to 'Bundle' as the condition causing the incorrect value; the source of the data update could not be verified. The affected orders, including VIN# FK72F-620004, were recovered, and the Product Bundle view was made read-only and released to PROD.

Root Cause: A master flag had been changed to 'Bundle', causing '0' to be passed instead of the net price for recycle fee orders. It was not possible to determine how the data was updated.
Resolution: Recovered the affected recycle fee orders and released a PROD change making the Product Bundle view read-only for all users, including admins.

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2396
Timestamp: 2024-07-19T06:59:03+00:00
Author: Abhishek Singh
Comment: Dear san,
In this case, if the vehicle was created by 'EIMADMIN' and the full model code is not 'FUSO-Gen' or 'Non-FUSO', the field 'Full Model Code' remains read-only. In that case, the 'Full Model Code' cannot be changed.
In other scenarios, you can change the value of the vehicle's 'Full Model Code'.
Also, if you have any doubts regarding "Trailer", you can edit it in that case. If you have any other questions, please let us know. 
Please review and approve the release to the production environment.
Thanks,
Abhishek Singh.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2381
Investigation Summary: The investigation confirmed that Account Type values, including "Employee", are displayed in the Account Name PickApplet because no filter excludes them. FDP configuration was copied from SC, where the same behavior exists. The requester identified the relevant mapped item after clarification, and the Jira was rejected as not being a system bug.
Important Findings: ['No filter exists in the Account Name PickApplet to exclude Account Type "Employee".', 'SC and SC UAT1 have the same configuration and do not exclude "Employee".', 'Displayed Account Type values are Employee, Individual, and Company.', 'Japanese Account Type values are Corporation for Company, Employee for Employee, and Individual for Individual.', 'Removing "Employee" from the account picklist would require an AMS-CR as an additional development requirement.']
Root Cause: No configuration filter exists in FDP or SC to exclude the "Employee" Account Type from the Account Name PickApplet.
Resolution: Clarified the mapped Account Type item to the requester and rejected the Jira because the behavior was not a system bug; an AMS-CR is required for any requested filtering change.
Technical Entities: ['Account Type', 'Employee', 'Individual', 'Company', 'Account Name PickApplet', 'account picklist', 'FDP', 'SC', 'SC UAT1', 'AMS-CR', 'Business Partner Type', 'Corporation']

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2375
Investigation Summary: A Delivery Request creation error occurred when purchase orders associated with a vehicle were not all mapped. Investigation found that a previously cancelled assessment for the same vehicle set a flag to 'Y' on all mapped POs; this flag was handled during sales order mapping but was not checked during Delivery Request creation. The Delivery Request logic was corrected, validated in UAT1 on AR# H000030031, and released to Prod.
Important Findings: ["A cancelled assessment sets a flag to 'Y' for all POs mapped to the associated vehicle.", 'For a subsequent assessment with the same VIN#, only the newest purchase orders are mapped in the sales order.', 'Delivery Request creation did not check the cancellation-related PO flag, causing the error that all purchase orders were not mapped.', 'The condition was fixed for Delivery Request creation and deployed to UAT1.', 'UAT passed on AR# H000030031, and the fix was released to Prod.']
Root Cause: Delivery Request creation did not check the 'Y' flag set on POs mapped to a vehicle when a prior assessment was cancelled, resulting in validation that all purchase orders were not mapped.
Resolution: Updated Delivery Request creation logic to check the cancellation-related PO flag; the change passed UAT1 validation and was released to Prod.
Technical Entities: ['Delivery Request', 'assessment', 'vehicle', 'POs', 'purchase orders', 'VIN#', 'sales order', 'UAT1', 'AR# H000030031', 'Prod']

Comment: We have analyzed this issue and we have found that in this record, there was an assessment created with the same vehicle, in cancelled status. Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2370
Investigation Summary: The incident concerned missing responsible/collector information on the accounts receivable update screen. Resolution: Implemented changes were validated in UAT-1 and released to Prod; users must set "Module open Flag NV" to True during "Update AR" to display NV responsible details.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2369
Investigation Summary: The initial assessment that each Body Line Item should retain one unique IBOS number across child sales orders was corrected. The expected FORCE behavior is to use one IBOS number at quotation and obtain an IBOS branch number from IBOS when an order is placed, then reflect that branch number in SIEBEL. Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2363
Investigation Summary: C/# data was not visible in the NV_Report after a column was added to W_ASSET_D for incident MFTBCFFR-2350. W_ASSET_D was fully loaded, but its dependent table was not fully loaded and became out of sync. A full load of the dependent table was completed after business hours, restoring correct C/# display in the NV report.
Important Findings: ['A column added to W_ASSET_D for MFTBCFFR-2350 required a full load of W_ASSET_D.', 'The dependent table of W_ASSET_D was not fully loaded, causing it to be out of sync.', 'The same issue occurred in FDP UAT and was resolved by fully loading the dependent table of W_ASSET_D.', 'The production full load was deferred until after business hours because it could impact the Siebel database.', 'After the dependent-table full load, C/# data displayed correctly in the NV report.']
Root Cause: The dependent table of W_ASSET_D was not fully loaded after W_ASSET_D was changed and fully loaded, leaving the dependent table out of sync.
Resolution: Performed a full load of the dependent table of W_ASSET_D after business hours; C/# data was then correctly displayed in the NV report.

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2360
Investigation Summary: Invoice issuance and KB Invoice details were unavailable for Headquarter employees/Sales Reps with Branch Code 00 because their code mapping was incorrect, while branch users with codes 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50 worked correctly. The issue also affected the UV Process, preventing Okayama Fuso from printing invoices. The mapping fix was validated in UAT1 and released to Okayama Production on 3 July.
Important Findings: ['Logic worked correctly for branch users with Branch Codes 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50.', 'Headquarter employee code mapping was incorrect, preventing invoice issuance for Sales Reps with Branch Code 00.', 'The UV Process was also affected; Okayama Fuso could not print invoices.', 'The fix was deployed to UAT1, validated, and approved for Production release.', 'After release to Okayama Production, KB Invoice details were available for all branchCodes.']
Root Cause: Incorrect code mapping for Headquarter employees/Sales Reps with Branch Code 00.
Resolution: Corrected the Headquarter employee code mapping, including the UV Process fix, validated the changes in UAT1, and released them to Okayama Production on 3 July.
Technical Entities: ['Branch Code 00', 'Branch Codes 10, 20, 30, 40, 50', 'Headquarter employees', 'Sales Rep', 'UAT1', 'Prod', 'Production', 'UV Process', 'Okayama Fuso', 'Okayama Production', 'KB Invoice details', 'FDP release']

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2346
Investigation Summary: The D21L received from TOB was not executed on 11 June because an ODI package failed. The DMS_Inbound directory contained too many files, causing an "Argument List too long" error. Recovery of the chassis order was completed after unnecessary files were moved to the Archive folder.
Important Findings: ['The D21L received from TOB was not executed on 11 June.', 'ODI reported an "Argument List too long" error and the package failed.', 'The failure occurred because the number of files in DMS_Inbound was too large.', 'Unnecessary files were moved from DMS_Inbound to the Archive folder.', 'Recovery for the affected chassis order was completed.', 'DMS_Inbound will be regularly cleaned by moving unnecessary files to the Archive folder.']
Root Cause: Excessive file volume in DMS_Inbound caused an ODI package to fail with "Argument List too long", preventing execution of the D21L received from TOB.
Resolution: Moved unnecessary files from DMS_Inbound to the Archive folder and completed recovery of the affected chassis order; regular archival will be performed to prevent recurrence.
Technical Entities: ['D21L', 'TOB', 'ODI', 'DMS_Inbound', 'Archive folder', 'Argument List too long', 'chassis order']

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2330
Investigation Summary: Branch-code validation for NV and UV invoices compared the received branch code with the Sales Order creator's branch, causing a "Branch code is incorrect" error when the Sales Rep belonged to a different branch. The validation was changed in UAT1 to compare against the Sales Rep's branch and was validated using sales order A001250445. The change was released to Prod on 7th June.
Important Findings: ["User D8YUTAGU had branch code 40, while the received branch code was 20, causing validation against the Sales Order creator's branch to fail.", 'The requested behavior was to set and validate the branch code based on the Sales Rep for NV, UV, and Delivery agency invoice.', "In UAT1, branch-code matching was changed from the Sales Order creator's branch to the Sales Rep's branch.", 'For sales order A001250445, the creator belonged to branch 50 and the Sales Rep belonged to branch 10; a request with branch code 10 received a correct response from Siebel.', 'An NV invoice was successfully created with branch code 10 before Prod approval.']
Root Cause: The branch-code validation compared the received branch code with the Sales Order creator's branch instead of the Sales Rep's branch.
Resolution: Updated the NV and UV branch-code validation to match the Sales Rep's branch, validated the change in UAT1, and released it to Prod on 7th June.
Technical Entities: ['NV', 'UV', 'Delivery agency invoice', 'Branch code', 'Sales Order', 'Sales Order creator', 'Sales Rep', 'D8YUTAGU', 'Okayama branch', 'UAT1', 'A001250445', 'Siebel', 'Prod', 'FDP release', 'Branch code is incorrect']

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2304
Investigation Summary: The NV Sales Order Report uses the "Sales Order Date" displayed in the UI. This field is editable for users whose primary-position division organization type is not "Branch", allowing users to alter the date and create report discrepancies. The incident was classified as user mis-operation rather than a system defect and rejected.
Important Findings: ['The NV Sales Order Report is generated from the "Sales Order Date" visible in the UI.', 'The "Sales Order Date" UI field is editable for users whose organization type is not "Branch" for their division of primary position.', 'User changes to the "Sales Order Date" can cause discrepancies in the NV Sales Order Report.', 'The issue was determined to be user mis-operation, not a system bug.']
Root Cause: Users eligible to edit the "Sales Order Date" field changed its value, and the NV Sales Order Report is generated using that editable UI date.
Resolution: The Jira was rejected because the discrepancy was classified as user mis-operation rather than a system bug.
Technical Entities: ['NV Sales Order Report', 'Sales Order Date', 'UI', 'Branch']

comments.comment:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2304
Timestamp: 2024-05-23T07:08:00
Author: Sunil Kumar
Comment: Thank you for your support.
We have done analysis and The root cause of this issue is explained below in details.
1.The NV Sales Order Report is generated based on the "Sales Order Date" visible in the user interface (UI). We have attached a screenshot of the UI for your reference.
2.The "Sales Order Date" field on the UI is editable for users whose organization type is not "Branch" for their division of primary position.
3.Therefore, users can change the value of the "Sales Order Date" field, causing discrepancies in the NV Sales Order Report.
Let us know if you have any query.
Best Regards,
Sunil Kumar

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2300
Investigation Summary: The approval-routing behavior was replicated and verified as operating according to the configured approval rule. The rule determines the approver from the Sales Rep Position Type of the user who created the JC, rather than the requestor. For JC I000050053 in Prod, the creator's MF Branch-Service-Mgr position routed approval to an MF Branch-Head.
Important Findings: ["The approval rule routes approvals based on the JC creator's Sales Rep Position Type.", 'MF Branch-Service-Mgr creators route to MF Branch-Head approvers.', 'MF Branch-Service-Staff creators route to MF Branch-Service-Mgr approvers.', 'In RT2, JC I000035277 created by MF Branch-Service-Mgr routed to MF Branch-Head, while JC I000035278 created by MF Branch-Service-Staff routed to MF Branch-Service-Mgr.', 'In Prod, JC I000050053 was created by D8SAKIYE (MF Branch-Service-Mgr); therefore, approval routed to D8HIRHIR (MF Branch-Head), despite the requestor D8SAYAGI being MF Branch-Service-Staff.']
Root Cause: Approval routing is determined by the JC creator's Sales Rep Position Type, not by the requestor's position type.

Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2283
Investigation Summary: Daily processing failed because the "period-end balance carryover" processing screen was left active in Okafusa. The failure caused irregular file management for IF files and control files received from Siebel, preventing proper control-file validation. After the screen was closed, the data import was rerun and completed successfully.
Important Findings: ['Okafusa was running the "period-end balance carryover" process at approximately 20:20, and its processing screen remained active.', 'Starting daily processing while the "period-end balance carryover" screen was active caused the initial error.', 'The failure caused irregular file management, including file backup processing, for IF files and control files linked from Siebel.', 'Irregular control-file handling prevented proper control-file validation.', 'The issue was cleared after the processing screen was closed, and the data import process completed successfully when rerun.']
Root Cause: The "period-end balance carryover" processing screen in Okafusa remained active when daily processing was started.
Resolution: The active "period-end balance carryover" screen was closed, and the data import process was rerun successfully.
Technical Entities: ['MDIS', 'Okafusa', 'period-end balance carryover', 'daily processing', 'Siebel', 'IF file', 'control file', 'data import process']

Since the processing screen was in the starting state, an error occurred when starting the daily processing.
(This morning (around 6:40), it seems that the person in charge of Okafugo closed the screen, and as a result, this error has been resolved.)

Root Cause: Microsoft-side Power BI Gateway/service issue, with the April 2024 gateway version suspected to contain a bug causing synchronization and Gateway unreachable/Offline refresh failures.

investigation_report:
Issue Key: MFTBCFFR-2257
Investigation Summary: The "Last DB Refresh Time" in the Okayama Power BI UAT report remained at the previous successful load time despite daytime report refreshes. Investigation found that the 12:00 PM ODI Load plan failed because duplicate database data was not permitted at an ODI processing step. The Load plan issue was fixed and monitored successfully for three days, after which daytime Power BI refreshes displayed the correct "Last DB Refresh Time".
Important Findings: ['The Power BI report refresh itself could complete while "Last DB Refresh Time" continued to show the last successful ODI daily Load plan run.', 'The 12:00 PM ODI Load plan failure was caused by duplicate data in the database that was not permitted at an ODI step.', 'The 21:30 Load plan run completed successfully after the duplicate-data issue was resolved.', 'The Load plan for UAT Okayama was fixed and ran successfully for three days during monitoring.', 'Scheduled Power BI refresh failures requiring manual refresh were identified as a separate issue tracked in MFTBCFFR-2274.']
Root Cause: Duplicate data in the database caused the 12:00 PM ODI Load plan to fail at a step where duplicates were not permitted, preventing "Last DB Refresh Time" from being updated.
Resolution: The UAT Okayama Load plan issue was fixed, the successful load runs updated "Last DB Refresh Time" correctly in daytime Power BI report refreshes, and the fix was monitored successfully for three days.
Technical Entities: ['Power BI', 'PBI', 'Okayama PBI UAT report', 'NV report', 'NV 3-06 report', 'Last DB Refresh Time', 'ODI Load plan', 'FDP UAT', 'UAT1 (Okayama)', 'UAT2 (Aomori)', 'UAT3 (Hakodate)', 'Power BI Gateway', 'Microsoft', 'MFTBCFFR2-189', 'MFTBCFFR-2274']
